items.summary: Fiserv (NasdaqGS:FISV) plans to migrate clients to a single debit network, preparing the other network for sale or wind-down. Management is reviewing underperforming operations across the group, with some non-core businesses earmarked for potential closure. The company is rolling out AI-powered eCommerce tools within its Clover platform to support online selling for small merchants.
